scope: Official standards, graph interoperability, dataset metadata, lineage, observability, bounded research APIs. Source-bound technical assessment, not a global market survey.
method: Official source documents inspected on 2026-09-13. Dated normative snapshots take precedence for status; current mutable landing pages are observation evidence only. No packages installed, services provisioned, or source webpage payloads archived by this scan.

sources.title: RDF 1.1 Concepts
sources.finding: Stable RDF graph/dataset model; published syntax and semantics suites provide the interoperability test surface.

sources.title: RDF Dataset Canonicalization 1.0
sources.finding: Canonical RDF dataset representation supports consistent hashing; a digest verifies bytes under the specified transform, not the truth of a claim.

sources.title: Shapes Constraint Language
sources.finding: SHACL validates data graph constraints relative to a shapes graph; it does not establish scientific validity.

sources.title: PROV-O
sources.finding: Entity, activity and agent provenance vocabulary supports derivation and attribution descriptions, distinct from causal identification.

sources.title: RDF 1.2 Concepts and Abstract Syntax
sources.finding: RDF 1.2 adds triple terms and other model changes. This dated snapshot is a Candidate Recommendation, not the latest final Recommendation.

sources.title: SPARQL 1.2 Query Language
sources.finding: Current draft observed one day before this scan; SPARQL 1.1 remains the latest Recommendation. A draft query feature does not justify changing HSWM's stable contract.

sources.title: SHACL 1.2 Core
sources.finding: New Core draft; SHACL 1.0 remains the final Recommendation used by HSWM's existing qualification.

sources.title: Data Catalog Vocabulary 3
sources.finding: Catalog metadata for datasets, distributions, data services, versions and dataset series; complements rather than replaces run provenance.

sources.title: DCAT Application Profile for data portals in Europe
sources.finding: DCAT-AP is used to exchange European public-sector dataset descriptions; this is a concrete institutional interoperability ecosystem, not an HSWM adoption requirement.
sources.source_date_note: Publication date not established; access date is not publication date.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 39075:2024 — GQL
sources.finding: GQL is a published international property-graph query-language standard; ISO also lists a 2026 correction. Full paid text was not inspected and no certification claim is made.

sources.title: Cypher GQL conformance
sources.finding: Neo4j documents supported and unsupported mandatory GQL features. Cypher support must not be described as complete GQL conformance.

sources.title: Croissant specification 1.1
sources.finding: JSON-LD/schema.org-based ML dataset metadata, including resources and records; this specification is not a W3C or ISO Recommendation.

sources.title: Croissant working group
sources.finding: MLCommons reports over 700,000 datasets accessible through Google Dataset Search and integrations including Hugging Face, Kaggle and OpenML; this is publisher-reported availability, not active scientific usage.
sources.source_date_note: Publication date not established; access date is not publication date.

sources.title: Croissant: A metadata format for ML-ready datasets
sources.finding: Google's launch documentation names Hugging Face, Kaggle and OpenML support and Dataset Search discovery; it establishes named integrations rather than comparative market share.

sources.title: OpenLineage documentation
sources.finding: Documentation observed as 1.53.0 describes Job, Run and Dataset lineage. Documentation/client release version differs from RunEvent JSON schema version.
sources.source_date_note: Publication date not established; access date is not publication date.

sources.title: OpenLineage facets
sources.finding: Facets extend core metadata with versioned schema URLs; custom HSWM facets must retain source revision and mapping boundaries.
sources.source_date_note: Publication date not established; access date is not publication date.

sources.title: OpenLineage Spark integration
sources.finding: Spark connector and documented Airflow/dbt/Flink/Spark ecosystem support integration feasibility; these are not measurements of scientific adoption.
sources.source_date_note: Publication date not established; access date is not publication date.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry Specification
sources.finding: Specification observed as 1.60.0. Tracing correlates execution observations; it does not identify causal credit or independently release outcomes.
sources.source_date_note: Publication date not established; access date is not publication date.

sources.title: GenAI spans semantic conventions
sources.finding: GenAI semantic conventions are in a dedicated repository and labeled Development; stable core tracing does not make all GenAI attributes stable.
sources.source_date_note: Publication date not established; access date is not publication date.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol revision 2026-07-28
sources.finding: Current dated protocol revision. HSWM already tracks it in acceptance metadata; tracking official SDK pins does not mean the native SDK has been installed.

sources.title: MCP 2026-07-28 changelog
sources.finding: The revision changes request-scoped protocol/capability metadata and protocol state assumptions. Adapter qualification must target the exact revision.

sources.title: OpenAlex API reference
sources.finding: Structured scholarly discovery through a REST API; records are metadata about works and their links, not scientific verification.
sources.source_date_note: Publication date not established; access date is not publication date.

sources.title: OpenAlex data reference
sources.finding: Documents linked scholarly entities; original papers and source dates are still needed to assess a scientific claim.
sources.source_date_note: Publication date not established; access date is not publication date.

sources.title: Crossref REST API
sources.finding: Searches member-deposited metadata, DOI records, funding/licensing, ORCID/ROR and post-publication updates including Retraction Watch inputs. Metadata may be incomplete; some abstracts retain copyright.
sources.source_date_note: Publication date not established; access date is not publication date.

candidates.name: RDF 1.1 + RDFC 1.0 + SHACL 1.0 + PROV-O
candidates.standard_status: W3C Recommendations; HSWM uses independently implemented, pinned engines qualified against scoped official suites.
candidates.adoption_evidence: Official Recommendations and suites support interoperability. This scan does not quantify use of this exact combination in science.
candidates.hswm_fit: Reuse existing KgBundleGraphView, N-Quads, SHACL and PROV-O projections; add source/decision/qualification edges.
candidates.cost_or_overlap: Already implemented and source-pinned in HSWM_GRAPH_STANDARDS_ACCEPTANCE.v1.json; no new graph engine needed.
candidates.qualification_needed: Preserve source hashes, directional relation identity, authority, mapping loss and paired query answers. New catalog references must resolve to declared source records; external live UID references retain explicit NOT_FOUND/NOT_CHECKED status where applicable, and ambiguous or incorrect identities are refused when unique resolution is required by the selected contract.
candidates.version_status: Dated official document or currently observed documentation; exact executable artefact is not selected by this scan.

candidates.name: RDF 1.2
candidates.standard_status: W3C Candidate Recommendation Snapshot, not final Recommendation.
candidates.adoption_evidence: Official working group candidate; adoption prevalence not established in this scan.
candidates.hswm_fit: Possible future statement-level metadata encoding experiment.
candidates.cost_or_overlap: HSWM already reifies typed source-bound records in stable RDF; triple terms alone do not preserve hyperedge ownership or causal semantics.
candidates.qualification_needed: Only isolate a mapping experiment if a concrete loss or query problem is demonstrated; run official relevant tests and preserve stable export.
candidates.version_status: Dated official document or currently observed documentation; exact executable artefact is not selected by this scan.

candidates.name: SPARQL 1.2
candidates.standard_status: W3C Working Draft, not final Recommendation.
candidates.adoption_evidence: Current official draft is evidence of development, not production standard conformance.
candidates.hswm_fit: Watch query improvements after RDF profile need is demonstrated.
candidates.cost_or_overlap: Existing SPARQL 1.1 and Cypher paired queries answer current navigation needs.
candidates.qualification_needed: Do not silently emit draft-only syntax in stable query packs; any pilot needs versioned engine and query-suite qualification.
candidates.version_status: Dated official document or currently observed documentation; exact executable artefact is not selected by this scan.

candidates.name: SHACL 1.2 Core
candidates.standard_status: W3C Working Draft, not final Recommendation.
candidates.adoption_evidence: Current official draft; broad use not established.
candidates.hswm_fit: Potential future shape capability evaluation only.
candidates.cost_or_overlap: Existing SHACL 1.0 scoped shapes and validator are already available.
candidates.qualification_needed: Keep candidate shapes in a separate profile, compare violations with stable shapes and document semantic differences.
candidates.version_status: Dated official document or currently observed documentation; exact executable artefact is not selected by this scan.

candidates.name: DCAT 3 / DCAT-AP
candidates.standard_status: W3C Recommendation plus a distinct European application profile.
candidates.adoption_evidence: European Commission's DCAT-AP provides concrete institutional metadata-exchange evidence.
candidates.hswm_fit: Useful when public HSWM dataset/release catalogs need discovery, version and distribution links.
candidates.cost_or_overlap: RO-Crate and Croissant cover different object/record detail; DCAT adds catalog discovery, not another run store.
candidates.qualification_needed: Map one public dataset series to releases and distributions while retaining DOI, SHA-256, licence and access distinction.
candidates.version_status: Dated official document or currently observed documentation; exact executable artefact is not selected by this scan.

candidates.name: ISO GQL and Cypher mapping
candidates.standard_status: ISO/IEC 39075:2024 standard; Neo4j Cypher is a vendor implementation with partial documented conformance.
candidates.verified_version: ISO/IEC 39075:2024, Cor 1:2026 listed; Neo4j feature matrix observed
candidates.adoption_evidence: Official ISO publication and vendor feature matrix establish standards/implementation status, not cross-vendor or scientific prevalence.
candidates.hswm_fit: Keep bounded property-graph queries portable where actually supported; preserve RDF as stable exchange.
candidates.cost_or_overlap: Existing Cypher/SPARQL answer parity does not establish full GQL or cross-engine conformance.
candidates.qualification_needed: Name exact engine/version and supported subset; run actual cross-engine cases only if a portability requirement arises.
candidates.version_status: Dated official document or currently observed documentation; exact executable artefact is not selected by this scan.

candidates.name: MLCommons Croissant
candidates.standard_status: MLCommons consortium open specification using JSON-LD/schema.org; not W3C/ISO.
candidates.adoption_evidence: MLCommons reports >700,000 discoverable datasets; Google documents Hugging Face/Kaggle/OpenML integrations. Availability is not an active-use or efficacy measure.
candidates.hswm_fit: Strong targeted addition for declared RU-1/fresh-task record schema and reproducible benchmark releases.
candidates.cost_or_overlap: Does not enforce holdout custody, prevent benchmark leakage or validate outcome correctness.
candidates.qualification_needed: Pilot one fixed, non-private benchmark descriptor; pin schema/validator, record/split/source hashes and licence; compare loaded record IDs exactly against native manifests.
candidates.version_status: Dated official document or currently observed documentation; exact executable artefact is not selected by this scan.

candidates.name: OpenLineage
candidates.standard_status: Open project event/facet specification plus independent integrations.
candidates.verified_version: Docs/release observed 1.53.0; existing HSWM RunEvent schema 2.0.2
candidates.adoption_evidence: Official Spark and other engine integrations demonstrate feasible connectors; scientific prevalence not measured.
candidates.hswm_fit: Reuse occurrence_publication.py terminal export and source-pinned custom facets.
candidates.cost_or_overlap: Already implemented; another lineage service adds operations unless a real external executor/dataset contract requires ingestion.
candidates.qualification_needed: Validate exact RunEvent2.0.2 and custom facet mapping, START/terminal identity and retries; test ingestion only for a named external integration.
candidates.version_status: Dated official document or currently observed documentation; exact executable artefact is not selected by this scan.

candidates.name: OpenTelemetry core
candidates.standard_status: CNCF project specification; release/SDK/semantic-convention versions are independent.
candidates.verified_version: Specification observed 1.60.0; HSWM has separately pinned SDK2.2.0 and API1.9.0
candidates.adoption_evidence: Official specification and SDK ecosystem are capability evidence; no usage ranking asserted.
candidates.hswm_fit: Reuse existing Effect OTLP SDK instrument to identify execution failures, cost and latency in selected experiments.
candidates.cost_or_overlap: Already implemented 2026-09-09; Phoenix real-service receipt remains unverified in source cut. Telemetry cannot supply independent custody or causal learning evidence.
candidates.qualification_needed: Verify selected trace/span correlation, bounded attributes and actual collector readback; keep raw bodies/private outputs out of public KG.
candidates.version_status: Dated official document or currently observed documentation; exact executable artefact is not selected by this scan.

candidates.name: OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions
candidates.standard_status: OpenTelemetry development conventions, separate from core specification.
candidates.verified_version: Development status at dedicated semantic-conventions-genai repository, observed 2026-09-13
candidates.adoption_evidence: Publisher's current development documentation; stable adoption not inferred.
candidates.hswm_fit: Track optional LLM-specific fields if existing bounded attributes cannot answer an actual diagnostic question.
candidates.cost_or_overlap: No reason to replace working core instrumentation or collect raw prompts by default.
candidates.qualification_needed: Pin exact convention revision and explicitly experimental attribute mapping; prove existing bounded trace export still works.
candidates.version_status: Dated official document or currently observed documentation; exact executable artefact is not selected by this scan.

candidates.name: Model Context Protocol
candidates.standard_status: Published open protocol revision; official SDK is implementation and Registry is discovery metadata.
candidates.adoption_evidence: Official versioned protocol and SDK ecosystem establish integration surface; Registry listings do not establish trust or adoption.
candidates.hswm_fit: Reuse existing bounded MCP/USL surfaces for graph or literature lookup. Native TS SDK2.0.0 is pinned in acceptance metadata but NOT_INSTALLED.
candidates.cost_or_overlap: Do not create generic canonical-write, learning or approval surfaces; skill workflows are separate from live MCP capabilities.
candidates.qualification_needed: For a concrete missing surface, exact capability allowlist, protocol revision, official SDK pins/licence/lockfile and isolated smoke test must precede adoption.
candidates.version_status: Dated official document or currently observed documentation; exact executable artefact is not selected by this scan.

candidates.name: OpenAlex + Crossref
candidates.standard_status: Official scholarly metadata APIs; services/data models, not proof or universal research standards.
candidates.verified_version: Current API/data documentation observed 2026-09-13; no executable version selected
candidates.adoption_evidence: Crossref documents member-deposited scholarly metadata and post-publication update sources. No use ranking or complete coverage claim.
candidates.hswm_fit: A bounded retrieval workflow can connect a claim, original paper/DOI, version/date, citation context and contradicting evidence.
candidates.cost_or_overlap: Existing web/USL/KG can already do bounded retrieval; a new agent framework or broad harvesting service is unnecessary.
candidates.qualification_needed: On one real HSWM literature question, resolve exact works, deduplicate versions, inspect originals and updates, preserve source URLs/access dates; metadata and citation counts never adjudicate truth.
candidates.version_status: Dated official document or currently observed documentation; exact executable artefact is not selected by this scan.
